docs.title: Transaction rollback and recovery
docs.text:
The deterministic U03/E01 case deliberately attempted separate_phase before material, volume and a settled phase system existed. The transaction rolled back, preserved physical state, observation RNG and ghost state, retained the declared attempt consequence, and continued from the last committed state.

Step Action Transaction Δ process time Role in recovery 1 Separate rolled_back 0.000 s Premature separation; rolled back 2 Solvent committed 0.000 s Committed recovery action 3 Reagent committed 0.000 s Committed recovery action 4 Catalyst committed 0.000 s Committed recovery action 5 Heat committed 1200.000 s Committed recovery action 6 Quench committed 18.298 s Committed recovery action 7 HPLC committed 0.000 s Process measurement 8 Add phase committed 0.000 s Committed recovery action 9 Extractant committed 0.000 s Committed recovery action 10 Mix committed 180.000 s Committed recovery action 11 Settle committed 360.000 s Committed recovery action 12 Separate committed 0.000 s Committed recovery action 13 Wash committed 0.000 s Committed recovery action 14 Dry committed 300.000 s Committed recovery action 15 Concentrate committed 600.000 s Committed recovery action 16 Transfer committed 0.000 s Committed recovery action 17 HPLC committed 0.000 s Process measurement 18 Terminate committed 0.000 s Explicit termination 19 Final assay committed 0.000 s Final assay closes the recovered lifecycle

The rejected attempt retained cost 0.03 and risk 0.08, while consuming no sample and no process time. The full 19-step submitted trace, including the rollback, replayed exactly.

docs.title: Controlled private-law changes
docs.text:
For each parent-child pair, ChemWorld held the public task, action schema, instrument surface, resources and typed action sequence fixed while changing one registered private component. Signed relative change follows the frozen qualification evaluator: sign(child-parent) * |child-parent| divided by the maximum of |parent|, |child| and the registered floor.

Intervention Seed Private target Physical response Public response Fixed gates Partition constitutive law 0 private_physics.constitutive_laws +21.36% +6.73% public contract, sequence, replay Partition constitutive law 1 private_physics.constitutive_laws +21.34% +7.69% public contract, sequence, replay Partition constitutive law 2 private_physics.constitutive_laws +21.36% +4.74% public contract, sequence, replay Electrochemical material law 0 private_physics.material_laws -5.25% -12.37% public contract, sequence, replay Electrochemical material law 1 private_physics.material_laws -5.03% -13.01% public contract, sequence, replay Electrochemical material law 2 private_physics.material_laws -2.42% -21.16% public contract, sequence, replay

docs.title: Interpretation boundary
docs.text:
• The agent trajectory demonstrates interface use and auditable execution, not model superiority.
  • The rollback case demonstrates transaction and recovery semantics, not a favorable-error selection.
  • The fork matrix establishes controlled changes for registered private-law interventions within the declared software-model domain; it does not imply physical-laboratory transfer.

Machine-readable values and exact source hashes are available in representative-behavior-and-forks.json.

docs.title: Interface availability
docs.text:
Current public access uses the Python environment and CLI. The former Student Lab command has been retired. Research Workbench and Blender Lab remain development prototypes and are not included in the public package.

Use the environment authoring guide to choose apparatus, set action/resource limits and connect your own agent. The static website's frozen trace viewer remains available as an illustration, not a live simulator.

docs.title: ChemWorld capability map
docs.text:
This is the frozen release map. See current foundation for the October update, including vessels, control, streams and configurable spectra.

This table is the reader-facing summary of the published surface. It describes what the world substrate and instrument contract expose; it does not claim that every row has been qualified in every possible combination.

docs.title: 1. Reusable components and interfaces
docs.text:
Component Public role Main operations Interfaces carried into composition Reaction Material transformation, selectivity and degradation add reagent, add solvent, add catalyst, heat, wait, sample, quench material, temperature, time, reaction event Thermal Heating, cooling, residence time and energy bookkeeping heat, wait, cool crystallize, evaporate, distill, run flow temperature, time, energy, safety Phase Phase creation, settling and phase identity add phase, mix, settle, separate phase phase, volume, composition, state identity Separation Extraction, washing, drying, concentration and transfer add extractant, wash, dry, concentrate, transfer material, phase, volume, sample identity Crystallization Seeding, cooling, crystal growth and filtration seed crystals, cool crystallize, filter crystals temperature, phase, crystal state, sample Distillation Evaporation, fractionation and fraction collection evaporate, distill, collect fraction temperature, phase, volatility, fraction Continuous flow Flow configuration and residence-time execution set flow rate, run flow flow rate, residence time, temperature, material Electrochemistry Potential/current control and electrochemical conversion set potential, electrolyze potential, current, charge, energy, material Observation Public measurements, masks, noise and terminal assay measure observable values, missingness, cost, latency, sample

The common composition paths currently exposed by the vocabulary are:

Composition pattern Required interface chain Typical use Reaction + thermal + observation material → temperature/time → measurement batch reaction and characterization Reaction + phase + separation + observation material → phase/volume → separation → measurement reaction followed by extraction or purification Reaction + thermal + crystallization + observation material → temperature/time → crystal state → measurement reaction to crystallization Reaction + thermal + distillation + observation material → temperature/phase → fraction → measurement reaction to distillation Reaction + thermal + continuous flow + observation material → flow/residence time → temperature → measurement continuous-flow reaction Reaction + electrochemistry + observation material → potential/current/charge → measurement electrochemical conversion Phase + observation phase/composition → measurement equilibrium or partition characterization

These are composition patterns, not a closed list of tasks. A new pattern is legal only when its component dependencies, units, state ownership, resource debits and lifecycle path are declared and accepted by the compatibility checker.

docs.title: 2. Public operation surface
docs.text:
The current public operation language contains 28 typed operation kinds, grouped as follows.

Group Operations Material and reaction setup add reagent, add solvent, add catalyst Batch control heat, wait, sample, quench Phase and separation add phase, add extractant, mix, settle, separate phase, wash, dry, concentrate, transfer Crystallization seed crystals, cool crystallize, filter crystals Distillation evaporate, distill, collect fraction Continuous flow set flow rate, run flow Electrochemistry set potential, electrolyze Lifecycle and observation terminate, measure

Every operation declares typed fields and preconditions. The public runtime rejects invalid fields, missing prerequisites, out-of-range values, incompatible units, exhausted resources and post-termination actions before they can mutate the committed physical state.

docs.title: 3. Continuous and categorical parameter axes
docs.text:
The following axes are available to authoring and task contracts. Bounds may be narrowed by a particular world, task, vessel or resource card; values are never silently remapped.

Axis Unit or type Current public domain Reagent amount mol non-negative and limited by the active safety/volume envelope Catalyst amount mol 0–0.005 mol per operation contract Added, phase, extractant, wash and sample volume L positive values bounded by operation, vessel and remaining sample volume Target temperature K operation-specific; current public families span approximately 250–430 K Duration and residence time s duration operations 1–14,400 s; flow residence time 1–7,200 s Stirring speed rpm 100–1,200 rpm where the operation exposes stirring Transfer fraction fraction 0.0001–1.0 Seed mass g 0.000001–0.050 g, with a cumulative cap Reflux ratio ratio 0–10 Flow rate mL min⁻¹ 0.01–20.0 Potential V −3.0–3.0 V, with electrochemical coupling checks Current mA 0.001–500 mA Solvent, phase, extractant, instrument and electrolyte profile categorical finite declared choices; unknown choices fail closed Operation, instrument and termination selection categorical finite contract-declared choices; no implicit fallback

Continuous axes are suitable for space-filling coverage. Categorical axes are suitable for covering-array coverage. The combination generator must report the selected coverage target and generated count rather than implying enumeration.

docs.title: 4. Instrument surface
docs.text:
All instruments are bounded virtual measurement contracts. Their cost, sample consumption, latency, observable channels, noise/missingness rules and termination requirements are part of the task contract.

Instrument Main observable families Cost Sample consumption Lifecycle rule HPLC conversion, yield, selectivity, purity, recovery, phase and product distribution 0.08 0.00020 L non-final measurement GC by-product, degradation and distillate-purity signals 0.06 0.00015 L non-final measurement UV–vis yield, conversion, selectivity, flow, electrochemical and transport signals 0.025 0.00005 L non-final measurement pH meter pH, dissociation, precipitation and equilibrium signals 0.018 0.00003 L non-final measurement Final assay endpoint channels across reaction, separation, crystallization, distillation, flow, electrochemistry and equilibrium 0.16 0.00030 L requires prior termination

An instrument exposes only the channels declared by the task. Private world laws, hidden mechanism parameters and world/fork lineage are not part of the agent-visible observation.

docs.title: 5. Resources, termination and evaluation
docs.text:
The public surface also includes the non-physical interfaces that make a composition an instrument rather than a collection of equations.

Surface What is explicit Resources operation attempts, vessel starts, stock, time, sample, instrument uses and terminal-assay budget Transactions precondition checks, atomic commit, rollback on failure, and no ghost state Termination explicit termination, final-assay precondition, discard/failure handling and no post-terminal actions Observations public fields, masks, noise, missingness and measurement cost/latency Evaluation endpoint definition, success metrics, safety limits, threshold semantics and declared task objective Replay committed actions, keyed observations, state transitions and resource consequences reconstructed from the same contract and seed

docs.title: 6. Reader boundary
docs.text: This map is a capability summary, not a benchmark scoreboard. It does not assert that all listed axes have been jointly qualified, that the world space is finite at the task level, or that the virtual modules predict arbitrary laboratory chemistry. Qualification results must state their tested compositions, denominators and failures separately from this map.

docs.title: ChemWorld world-composition contract
docs.text:
This page describes the frozen public release. Current main supports component networks; see current foundation for the updated runtime and compatibility-report fields. The original qualification remains historical.

This document defines the reader-facing authoring boundary for the published release. It is a bounded composition contract, not a claim that every possible chemical workflow or every combination of modules has been implemented or qualified.

The external claim is deliberately bounded:

ChemWorld supports open construction within the declared component vocabulary and compatibility domain. Qualification uses coverage-guided compositions and frozen unseen compositions; it is not an exhaustive proof over all possible tasks.

docs.title: 1. Object hierarchy
docs.text:
The authoring language keeps six objects separate.

Object Meaning Component A reusable physical, instrument, transactional, resource or observation module. World A compatible set of components, parameters and private laws that share one runtime state. Task contract The public goal and operating surface attached to a world. Scenario One task contract with concrete initial state, parameters, seed and intervention choice. Trajectory The committed operation--observation sequence produced by an agent in one scenario. World fork A controlled parent--child intervention that changes one declared private component while holding the public contract fixed.

The task contract is written as

[ T = (W, S_0, A, I, O, R, \tau, E), ]

where W is the world, S0 the initial state, A the allowed operations, I the instruments, O the public observations, R the resource ledger, τ the termination rule and E the evaluation surface.

docs.title: 2. Component vocabulary
docs.text:
The published vocabulary is finite and named at the level a reader can understand. A concrete world may use a subset, provided all dependencies and interfaces are satisfied.

Component kind Main responsibility Typical public interfaces reaction Material transformation and reaction events material, temperature, time, state transition thermal Heating, cooling, residence time and energy accounting temperature, heat, time, energy phase Phase identity, equilibrium or phase-state transitions phase, volume, composition, state identity separation Mixing, settling, extraction, washing, transfer and drying material, phase, volume, sample identity crystallization Seeding, cooling crystallization and filtration temperature, phase, crystal state, sample distillation Evaporation, fractionation and collection temperature, phase, volatility, fraction continuous_flow Flow configuration and residence-time execution flow rate, residence time, material, energy electrochemistry Potential/current control and electrochemical conversion charge, potential, current, energy, material observation Public measurements, masks, noise and assay outputs observable values, masks, cost, latency

The vocabulary is extensible by versioning the contract. Adding a new component kind or interface is a new contract version, not an undocumented field in an existing authoring file.

docs.title: 3. Declarative authoring form
docs.text:
The following is the public shape of a composition request. It is intentionally readable; implementation-specific identities, hashes and private-law payloads are not part of the agent-facing contract.

schema_version: chemworld-world-composition-0.1
composition_id: authored-reaction-purification
world_split: public-test
components:
  - kind: reaction
    role: transformation
    parameters:
      family: declared-reaction-family
      controls: [reagent, catalyst, solvent, temperature, time]
  - kind: thermal
    role: temperature-and-energy
    parameters:
      temperature_range_K: [280.0, 420.0]
  - kind: phase
    role: phase-state
    parameters:
      phases: [aqueous, organic]
  - kind: separation
    role: downstream-processing
    parameters:
      operations: [add_phase, mix, settle, separate_phase, wash, dry]
  - kind: observation
    role: public-measurement
    parameters:
      instruments: [hplc, final_assay]

task:
  objective: balanced
  budget: 10
  operations: [add_solvent, add_reagent, heat, add_phase, mix, settle,
               separate_phase, terminate, measure]
  instruments: [hplc, final_assay]
  observations: partial-instrument-observation
  resources:
    operation_budget: 10
    sample_volume_L: 0.001
    time_s: 3600
    instrument_uses: 2
    final_assays: 1
    # Optional for generated/open-agent tasks:
    # process_time_policy: required workflow envelope plus explicit repeat/implicit-time allowances
  termination: final-assay-or-budget
  evaluation:
    metrics: [score, purity, recovery, process_mass_balance_error]
    threshold: 0.55

The request is a construction description, not a trajectory. A scenario supplies concrete parameter values, initial-state values and a seed after the world and task contract have been compiled.

For coverage-generated tasks, resources.process_time_policy is the executable explanation of resources.time_s. It decomposes the envelope into timed_stage_max_s, an explicit implicit_stage_reserve_s for quench/transfer/filter/separation operations, and repeat_allowance_s; it also records required and additional repeat counts for every operation. The runtime checks this policy before committing an action and exposes used_s, limit_s, and remaining_s on the public campaign state. A hand-set single cap without this derivation is not sufficient for an open agent action space.

docs.title: Runtime entry point
docs.text:
The same request is accepted by the public compiler and environment constructor:

import gymnasium as gym
import chemworld

request = {
    "schema_version": "chemworld-world-composition-0.1",
    "composition_id": "composed-reaction-assay-demo",
    "world_split": "public-dev",
    "components": [
        {"kind": "reaction", "role": "transformation", "parameters": {}},
        {"kind": "thermal", "role": "temperature-and-energy", "parameters": {}},
        {"kind": "observation", "role": "public-measurement", "parameters": {}},
    ],
    "task": {"budget": 8, "resources": {"operation_budget": 8}},
}

compiled = chemworld.compile_world_composition(request)
env = gym.make("ChemWorld", composition=compiled, seed=0)
observation, info = env.reset(seed=0)

compiled.to_public_dict() and info["composition"] expose the same component, interface, operation, instrument, resource, termination, evaluation and accepted compatibility surface. chemworld.check_world_composition_compatibility(request) returns the same pre-execution decision without constructing an environment. Rejected compilation raises WorldCompositionError; its diagnostics identify a stable rejection class and request path.

Complete public requests for a single process module, a cross-module world and a multi-stage world are collected in Public world-authoring examples. The same page maps all 15 registered reference tasks onto the component and task-contract hierarchy and keeps controlled world forks separate from general composition.

docs.title: 4. Interface and parameter rules
docs.text:
Every component declares the inputs it consumes, the outputs it produces, the units of numeric fields, and the state/event identities it may update. Interfaces are checked before execution and remain visible at the public-contract level only where the task permits them.

Parameters fall into four classes:

  1. Categorical choices, such as a solvent family, phase role or instrument kind;
  2. Continuous values with declared units and closed bounds, such as temperature, time, volume, current or flow rate;
  3. Discrete values, such as stage counts, fraction identifiers or operation limits; and
  4. Seeded values controlling initial state and declared randomness, which are replay keys rather than public hidden-law fields.

The compiler must reject a request before execution when a parameter is missing, outside its declared domain, expressed in an incompatible unit, or attached to a component that does not own that field. A valid composition must expose a complete public surface for operations, instruments, observations, resources, termination and evaluation.

The published authoring parameters are deliberately finite:

Component Accepted parameter fields Reaction family, controls Thermal temperature_range_K, duration_range_s Phase phases Separation operations Crystallization temperature_range_K, seed_mass_range_g Distillation temperature_range_K, reflux_ratio_range, fraction_count Continuous flow flow_rate_range_mL_min, residence_time_range_s, temperature_range_K Electrochemistry potential_range_V, current_range_mA, duration_range_s Observation instruments

Plain numeric values use the unit named by the field. A unit-bearing value uses {value: [...], unit: degC} or the corresponding scalar form; compatible units are converted before bounds are checked. Accepted authored ranges narrow the runtime operation validator, so a value outside the declared range is not merely documented—it is rejected before state mutation.

docs.title: 5. Compatibility and exclusion rules
docs.text:
Compatibility is defined by interfaces and state ownership, not by a task name.

  • A state-changing component must have a typed material or process-state input and a declared output event.
  • A downstream component may consume an upstream output only when material identity, quantity, units and phase/state meaning are compatible.
  • Components that require a phase, thermal, electrical or flow interface cannot be used without the corresponding provider or an explicit adapter in the contract.
  • Every committed transition must remain inside the shared constitution: non-negative amounts, applicable mass/charge/energy checks, safety limits, resource debits and lifecycle rules.
  • Public observations may expose only fields declared by the task contract. Private world laws, component identities and lineage are evaluator-visible but not agent-visible.
  • A final evaluation must have a reachable termination path and a valid terminal observation; a composition that can never close its lifecycle is rejected before qualification.

The following are representative rejection classes, not a promise that the list is exhaustive:

Rejection Example Missing dependency crystallization requested without a phase or thermal path Interface mismatch a volume-valued output wired to a temperature input Conflicting ownership two modules both claim authority over the same phase transition Invalid parameter negative volume, out-of-range potential or unsupported instrument Lifecycle hole no reachable termination or final-assay path Resource impossibility required operation path exceeds the declared sample, time or attempt budget

docs.title: 6. Composition versus world forks
docs.text: General composition selects multiple compatible components. A world fork is narrower: it is an attribution experiment derived from a valid parent world and changes exactly one declared private component while preserving the public action, observation, instrument, resource, failure, scoring and task contract. Fork syntax must not be used to imply arbitrary multi-component authoring.

docs.title: 7. Coverage boundary
docs.text:
The composition space is open within the declared vocabulary, but qualification is finite and coverage-guided. Discrete axes are sampled with covering-array logic; continuous axes use space-filling samples; ordered operation paths cover declared interactions such as reaction-to-separation or reaction-to-crystallization. The sample count is determined by the coverage target and declared depth, not by a claim of enumeration.

The 15 registered tasks are reference points in this space. A frozen unseen composition must not occur in that reference set, must be generated after the constructor and compatibility rules are frozen, and must run through the same construction, execution, termination and replay path without a core-runtime patch.

docs.title: 8. Claim boundary
docs.text:
This contract supports claims about:

  • declared components and their public interfaces;
  • fail-closed construction and compatibility checking;
  • coverage-guided composition and finite unseen-composition qualification;
  • transactional, resource, observation-boundary and exact-replay semantics; and
  • agent use of a newly generated world as an instrument demonstration.

It does not support claims about exhaustive task coverage, arbitrary third-party worlds, universal agent intelligence, causal model rankings, physical-laboratory transfer or the validity of every possible chemical law outside the declared model-card domains.

docs.title: Coverage-guided composition generation
docs.text: ChemWorld generates a finite qualification suite from a declared coverage target. The generator is not an enumerator of all possible worlds and its report explicitly records that no exhaustive-coverage claim is made.

docs.title: Three coverage layers
docs.text:
Layer Qualification method Reported denominator Discrete authoring axes deterministic pairwise covering rows all declared value pairs across every pair of axes Continuous workflow axes seeded Latin hypercube samples one stratum per sample and continuous axis Ordered workflow interactions contiguous operation subsequences at the declared depth union of declared workflow interactions

The emitted case count is the largest of the three finite requirements: pairwise rows, continuous samples and workflow templates. Shorter designs are cycled so every required row, sample and workflow appears at least once. The generator does not form their Cartesian product.

docs.title: Public Python entry point
docs.text:
import chemworld

suite = chemworld.generate_world_composition_coverage(
    base_request,
    suite_id="reaction-assay-coverage",
    discrete_axes=(
        chemworld.DiscreteCoverageAxis(
            axis_id="world_split",
            bindings=("world_split",),
            values=("public-dev", "public-test"),
        ),
        chemworld.DiscreteCoverageAxis(
            axis_id="instrument_profile",
            bindings=(
                "components.observation.parameters.instruments",
                "task.instruments",
            ),
            values=(
                ["hplc", "final_assay"],
                ["gc", "final_assay"],
                ["uvvis", "final_assay"],
            ),
        ),
    ),
    continuous_axes=(
        chemworld.ContinuousCoverageAxis(
            axis_id="temperature_K",
            lower=310.0,
            upper=390.0,
            unit="K",
        ),
    ),
    workflows=(
        chemworld.OrderedWorkflowTemplate(
            workflow_id="heat-then-assay",
            actions=(
                {"operation": "add_solvent", "volume_L": 0.03, "solvent": 2},
                {"operation": "add_reagent", "amount_mol": 0.01},
                {
                    "operation": "heat",
                    "target_temperature_K": {
                        "coverage_axis": "temperature_K"
                    },
                    "duration_s": 600.0,
                    "stirring_speed_rpm": 600.0,
                },
                {"operation": "terminate"},
                {"operation": "measure", "instrument": "final_assay"},
            ),
        ),
    ),
    target=chemworld.CompositionCoverageTarget(
        discrete_strength=2,
        continuous_samples=8,
        ordered_interaction_depth=2,
        seed=0,
    ),
)

Discrete bindings may target world_split, task fields, nested task resource or evaluation fields, and component parameters. One discrete value may bind multiple paths so an instrument profile can update both the observation component and task surface atomically.

Continuous values enter workflows through an exact {"coverage_axis": "axis_id"} placeholder. Every declared continuous axis must appear in at least one workflow; unused coordinates are rejected rather than reported as covered.

docs.title: Fail-closed behavior
docs.text:
Every generated request is compiled through the same compatibility checker as an authored world. Every materialized action must belong to the compiled operation surface and pass the public action schema. If any case fails, generation raises WorldCompositionCoverageError with a readable report containing the exact attempted denominator and every failed case; a partial suite is not returned as successful output.

For a successful suite, suite.report contains:

  • the frozen target and generated case count;
  • exact required and covered counts for all three coverage layers;
  • the number of pairwise rows, continuous samples and workflows;
  • attempted, successful and failed case counts;
  • an explicit exhaustive_enumeration_claim: false boundary; and
  • a zero failure count with an empty failure list.

Coverage construction is therefore distinct from physical or transactional qualification. The suite says which cases and ordered interactions were selected; later qualification must execute them and report its own denominators and failures.

docs.title: Public world-authoring examples
docs.text:
These requests are retained from the frozen release and still compile on current main. Their old pattern labels are historical: current reports use component-network, with vessel-qualified state owners. See current foundation.

ChemWorld uses one object hierarchy for authored compositions and the 15 registered reference tasks: components form a world, a task contract supplies the operating surface, a scenario fixes initial state and seeds, and execution produces a trajectory. A controlled world fork is a narrower object derived from a valid world; it is not another spelling of general composition.

The examples below are construction requests. Successful compilation establishes a valid public contract, not physical qualification, task-space enumeration or agent performance.

docs.title: Example matrix
docs.text:
Authoring case Declared components What it demonstrates Single process module phase + mandatory observation A world may expose one process component while still carrying the observation and lifecycle surface required for execution. Cross-module world reaction + thermal + observation Two process components share material, temperature, time, energy and measurement interfaces. Multi-stage world reaction + thermal + phase + separation + observation Reaction and downstream purification operations are compiled into one task contract and one shared runtime state. Controlled fork one valid parent world plus one private-law intervention The public task surface stays fixed while exactly one declared private component changes for attribution.

The corresponding public files are:

  • examples/world-authoring/composed-equilibrium-characterization-v0.1.json;
  • examples/world-authoring/composed-reaction-assay-v0.1.json;
  • examples/world-authoring/composed-reaction-purification-v0.1.json; and
  • examples/world-authoring/mechanism-fork-v0.1.json and examples/world-authoring/material-law-fork-v0.1.json for controlled forks.

The phrase “single process module” excludes the mandatory observation component. Every executable Each composition must still expose public measurement and a reachable terminal evaluation.

docs.title: Frozen pre-launch reference paths
docs.text:
Compilation alone does not establish that an authoring example can complete a lifecycle. The The published use-case qualification therefore freezes two deterministic paths in examples/world-authoring/use-case-reference-paths-v0.1.json and executes them in the example tests.

  • U02 uses the phase + observation example with the supported balanced objective and a five-action budget. It adds solvent and reagent to create a measurable sample, performs one pH measurement, terminates and commits one final assay. UV--Vis remains an available but unselected instrument.
  • U03 uses the multi-stage reaction--phase--separation example with the supported balanced objective. Its first submitted action deliberately attempts phase separation before phase preparation and must roll back with precondition_failed while preserving physical state. The following 18 actions execute the legal reaction, measurement, extraction, purification, termination and final-assay recovery path.

These paths are public construction and lifecycle checks, not agent-performance measurements or physical-laboratory validation.

docs.title: Compile an example
docs.text:
import json
from pathlib import Path

import chemworld

request = json.loads(
    Path(
        "examples/world-authoring/composed-reaction-purification-v0.1.json"
    ).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
)
compiled = chemworld.compile_world_composition(request)

print(compiled.compatibility.pattern)
print(compiled.task_spec.allowed_operations)
print(compiled.to_public_dict()["task"]["resources"])

The compiler checks component dependencies, state ownership, parameter units and bounds, operation and instrument surfaces, resource reachability and lifecycle closure before an environment is constructed. The multi-stage example deliberately declares its complete separation surface so the component-owned operations and task-owned operations can be compared directly.

docs.title: How the 15 reference tasks fit the same contract
docs.text:
The registered tasks are reference points, not the extent of the composition space. Their world surfaces fall into eight declared component patterns:

Component pattern Registered reference tasks reaction + thermal + observation reaction-to-assay, reaction-optimization-standard, reaction-safety-constrained, reaction-mechanism-explanation, low-budget-characterization, public-private-generalization reaction + thermal + phase + separation + observation reaction-to-purification, purity-yield-tradeoff, tool-agent-planning phase + separation + observation partition-discovery reaction + thermal + crystallization + observation reaction-to-crystallization reaction + thermal + distillation + observation reaction-to-distillation reaction + thermal + continuous flow + observation flow-reaction-optimization reaction + electrochemistry + observation electrochemical-conversion phase + observation equilibrium-characterization

Tasks sharing a component pattern remain distinct through the task-contract overlay: objective, budget, episode mode, allowed operations and instruments, observation and termination policies, success metrics, world split and seeds. Scenarios then bind concrete initial state and hidden parameters without changing that public hierarchy.

The machine-readable mapping is examples/world-authoring/reference-task-contract-map-v0.1.json. It is checked against the public task registry and the composition compatibility checker. The mapping does not claim that an authoring example reproduces a frozen registered task byte for byte, and it does not transfer a qualification result from a reference task to a new composition.

docs.title: Composition and controlled forks stay separate
docs.text:
General authoring selects a compatible component set and task surface. A controlled fork starts from one already valid world, changes exactly one registered private-law target and preserves the public action, observation, instrument, resource, failure, scoring and task contract. Use the composition examples to create worlds and the fork examples only for controlled attribution.

This separation is why the same hierarchy can describe both open construction and controlled branching without treating the 15 reference tasks as an exhaustive benchmark catalogue.

docs.title: World foundations
docs.text:
Current main: October foundation update. Existing figures and numerical evidence below describe the frozen August runtime.

ChemWorld separates what an experimental agent may observe from what an experiment author may control. That separation makes causal world families possible without turning hidden evaluator state into an answer key.

docs.title: The public contract
docs.text: Every task exposes typed operations, parameter bounds, instruments, resource limits, termination rules and evaluation-facing outputs. The contract is stable enough for an agent, planner or RL policy to inspect before acting.

docs.title: The composed world
docs.text: World authors combine reaction, thermal, phase, separation, crystallization, distillation, flow, electrochemical and observation components through a compatibility-checked composition contract. A valid world must satisfy the registered interfaces before an episode starts.

docs.title: Controlled changes
docs.text: Parent and child worlds can differ in one registered law while holding the public experiment fixed. This supports a precise question: can an agent notice that an old local model no longer predicts its observations, and choose a better next intervention?

docs.title: Research directions
docs.text:
The stable release enables future studies of repeated experimentation, belief updating, informative intervention selection and mechanism-level multiple-choice judgments. These are research directions, not claims about unpublished experiments or results.

Status: the software substrate and finite qualification evidence are public; ongoing experimental matrices, intermediate results and private evaluator materials are not part of this release.

Start with the controlled-world notebook or read the world composition contract.

docs.title: ChemWorld README banner
docs.text: Generated with the built-in OpenAI ImageGen tool on 2026-10-20. The illustration is conceptual project artwork, not a simulation output or apparatus specification. Final asset: chemworld-readme-banner.png.

docs.title: Generation prompt
docs.text:
Use case: ads-marketing / stylized-concept.
Asset type: hero banner for the GitHub README of the open-source ChemWorld project. Create a finished premium editorial science illustration, very wide landscape 3:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2400 by 800 pixels.
Primary request: communicate a programmable, modular chemical world for autonomous experimentation. Calm, precise, sophisticated research-software identity, generous negative space and strong legibility at GitHub README width.
Composition: the left 40 percent is a clean typography area, the right 60 percent is an elegant continuous miniature laboratory landscape in refined isometric perspective. On a single pale modular platform, show a transparent jacketed chemical reactor on a restrained copper thermal connection, a small membrane separation cell and finite liquid reservoirs joined by purposeful tubing, an upright compact battery cell, and a crystalline specimen. Small sparse molecular motifs and very fine technical construction lines subtly connect the devices. Visually coherent apparatus, not a collage of panels. The shared modular laboratory is the protagonist; no humanoid robots, no people.
Style: high-end scientific editorial illustration combining delicate three-dimensional frosted glass and ceramic forms, subtle fine-line technical details, soft studio shadows, matte textures. Warm ivory background, deep ink/navy typography, restrained teal liquids and copper/amber thermal accents. Clean luminous presentation with excellent contrast; no neon, no purple gradients, no busy HUD, no stars, no excessive glow.
Text, exactly and only: large title 'ChemWorld' on the left, and underneath smaller two-line subtitle 'Programmable worlds.' and 'Autonomous experiments.' Use impeccable modern sans-serif typography. Keep all text within safe margins of 7 percent from the image edge.
Constraints: this is a conceptual project illustration, not a quantitative figure. No charts, axes, plots, measurements, benchmark numbers, invented chemical formulae, extra labels, third-party logos, badges or watermark. Full-bleed rectangular background, no browser frame, no mock website, no card border. Render as one polished image.

docs.title: Generation prompt
docs.text:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: a finished architecture diagram image for the GitHub README of ChemWorld, an open-source simulation foundation. Create a crisp wide landscape image, approximately 2400 by 1200 pixels, aspect ratio 2:1. It must be readable when displayed at 1000 pixels wide.
Primary request: turn the following exact software architecture into a beautifully composed, scientifically sober visual. The diagram has five groups: Physical world, Task, ChemWorldRuntime, Experimental history, and a four-interface group. All wording below is exact.
Layout: two small cards stacked on the left; Physical world above Task. A larger central ChemWorldRuntime card vertically centered between them. A spacious Experimental history card on the right. Beneath the central card, a single horizontal Interfaces group with four evenly spaced pills: Python, Gym, CLI, Agent. The bottom group must not visually overlap any card or connector. Use generous whitespace and balanced alignment. Content occupies the full useful width with safe outer margins.
Connections, exactly: Physical world has one right-pointing arrow into ChemWorldRuntime. Task has a separate right-pointing arrow into ChemWorldRuntime. ChemWorldRuntime has one right-pointing arrow into Experimental history. The Interfaces group has one vertical double-headed arrow connecting to ChemWorldRuntime. There are no other arrows. Paths are clean, orthogonal where needed, with obvious arrowheads, no crossings and no floating endpoints. Do not imply four independent runtime engines.
Text, exact, grouped as follows:
Left upper card title: "Physical world"
Left upper card subtitle: "Materials · Equipment · Models"
Left lower card title: "Task"
Left lower card subtitle: "Goals · Permissions · Budgets"
Central card title: "ChemWorldRuntime"
Central card subtitle: "Execute · Measure · Record"
Right card title: "Experimental history"
Right card subtitles on two lines: "State · Observations" and "Resources · Replay"
Lower group label: "Interfaces"
Lower group pills: "Python", "Gym", "CLI", "Agent".
Style: premium editorial technical infographic in the same restrained identity as a modular scientific laboratory: warm ivory background #FAF7F1, deep ink/navy typography #102435, muted teal #247E82, and sparse copper #B9784C. Mostly flat technical drawing with subtle paper-like depth and extremely soft shadows. Large modern sans-serif typography with precise spelling. Central card has a pale teal fill and a stronger teal border; other cards have warm white surfaces and delicate borders. Arrow lines and arrowheads are dark teal and clearly visible. Small elegant line icons may accompany the headings: a vessel for Physical world, a target for Task, an interconnected process motif for ChemWorldRuntime, and stacked records for Experimental history. Icons must be subordinate to text.
Constraints: absolutely no extra headings, slogans, text, equations, code, numbers, watermarks, logos, graphs, flow stages or decorative arrows. Do not draw a screenshot, browser window or full web page. Do not use a dark background, neon colors, gradients or a 3D laboratory montage. Every label must be large enough to read in a README. Preserve all five groups and exactly the four specified connections. Render the finished diagram directly as one image.

docs.title: 文档
docs.text: 从安装 ChemWorld、设计实验环境，到接入自己的智能体。本指南说明公开实现的接口、模型与适用范围。

docs.title: 按目标开始
docs.text: 我想…… 从这里开始 运行第一个实验 五分钟开始 选择部件、操作与测量 设计实验环境 操作环境并定义奖励 使用环境 接入自己的智能体 Agent 接口 跟随可执行示例学习 Notebook 教程

docs.title: 理解模型与接口
docs.text:
• 世界基座：状态、物理模型与实验合同。
  • 原生基座：已支持的模型及其有限适用范围。
  • API 参考：接口、参数与可执行示例。
  • 当前进展：本次公开快照包含的功能。
  • 证据与适用边界：已验证的内容与尚未覆盖的范围。

项目介绍、能力图谱与已记录的实验案例，请访问 ChemWorld 官网。

docs.title: 接入 Agent
docs.text:
新应用从环境API和环境作者指南开始。可使用自己的规划器与奖励，也可完全不评分。下文按任务评分的runner与预设适配器属于保留的历史应用；其命令入口为python -m chemworld.legacy.cli。

ChemWorld Agent 每一步都从公开任务状态中选择一个有类型的操作。隐藏世界状态由评测器持有；环境 负责校验请求、记录资源并生成可精确回放的轨迹。建议先跑离线 Agent，再接入外部模型。

docs.title: 能力矩阵
docs.text:
路径 网络或凭据 用途 公开状态 自定义 Python Agent 不需要 自己的规划器或策略 稳定协议 内置经典 Agent 不需要 连通性检查与可复现基线 稳定 Replay Agent 不需要 重放已经捕获的模型轨迹 稳定 DeepSeek LiveLLMAgent DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 操作级在线模型实验 可选适配器 Codex subscription client 已完成 codex login 通过 ChatGPT subscription 调用结构化输出 可选适配器 Interactive Codex experiment 已完成 codex login 每个完整实验保留一个模型上下文 高级 API Frozen SB3 policy 本地 checkpoint 与 .[rl] 评估已经训练好的 RL 策略 可选 extra

命令行 --agent 只暴露无需构造参数的内置 Agent。需要凭据、模型、replay 文件、checkpoint 或 workspace 的 Agent，应在 Python 中显式创建并传给 run_agent。

docs.title: 最小自定义 Agent
docs.text:
继承 BaseAgent 会自动声明零外部资源。决策时只能使用公开任务信息和公开历史。

from chemworld.agents.base import BaseAgent, HistoryRecord
from chemworld.eval.runner import run_agent


class TutorialAgent(BaseAgent):
    name = "tutorial"

    recipe = (
        {"operation": "add_solvent", "volume_L": 0.030, "solvent": 1},
        {"operation": "add_reagent", "amount_mol": 0.012},
        {"operation": "add_catalyst", "catalyst": 2, "catalyst_amount_mol": 0.0004},
        {"operation": "heat", "target_temperature_K": 350.0, "duration_s": 1200.0,
         "stirring_speed_rpm": 800.0},
        {"operation": "measure", "instrument": "hplc"},
        {"operation": "quench"},
        {"operation": "terminate"},
        {"operation": "measure", "instrument": "final_assay"},
    )

    def act(self, history: list[HistoryRecord]) -> dict[str, object]:
        return dict(self.recipe[len(history)])


run_agent(
    env_id="ChemWorld",
    agent=TutorialAgent(),
    world_split="public-dev",
    budget=8,
    objective="balanced",
    seed=0,
    task_id="reaction-to-assay",
    output_path="runs/tutorial-agent.jsonl",
)

更完整的 Agent 可以实现 act_with_context(context) 或 act_with_public_view(context, public_view)。官方 runner 会提供当前合法操作、资源、观测摘要和 生命周期状态，但不会泄露隐藏真值。

docs.title: 离线 Agent
docs.text:
chemworld tasks list
python -m chemworld.legacy.cli run --task reaction-to-assay --agent scripted_chemistry --seed 0

其他无需参数的名称包括 random、lhs、greedy、gp_bo、rf_ei、 safe_gp_bo、tool_using_llm_stub 和 llm_replay。Python 中可使用 chemworld.legacy.agent_registry.make_agent(name)。

docs.title: DeepSeek 在线适配器
docs.text:
不要把 key 写入源码：

export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="..."

from chemworld.legacy.agents.live_llm import LiveLLMAgent
from chemworld.eval.runner import run_agent
from chemworld.providers.deepseek import DeepSeekClient

agent = LiveLLMAgent(
    DeepSeekClient(model="deepseek-v4-pro", thinking=True),
    role_id="public-example",
)

run_agent(
    env_id="ChemWorld",
    agent=agent,
    world_split="public-dev",
    budget=18,
    objective="balanced",
    seed=0,
    task_id="reaction-to-assay",
    output_path="runs/deepseek-reaction-to-assay.jsonl",
)

模型身份、重试、token 与估算成本会独立记录；Provider 失败不会被静默替换成其他模型或宿主动作。

docs.title: Codex subscription
docs.text:
安装 Codex CLI，并用 ChatGPT subscription 完成 codex login。然后从 chemworld.providers.codex_subscription 创建 CodexSubscriptionClient，按上面的方式传给 LiveLLMAgent。subscription 无法提供逐次调用的美元价格，因此 receipt 会明确记录这一限制。

InteractiveCodexExperimentAgent 用于在一个完整实验内保持同一 Codex 上下文。它要求显式指定 隔离 workspace 和 role ID；正式比较前应阅读类说明和对应测试。

docs.title: 可复现与安全边界
docs.text:
• 不提交 API key、Provider 原始响应或隐藏推理。
  • 任务、seed、模型身份、prompt 合同和资源上限不一致时，不比较 live-agent 分数。
  • 对外报告分数前必须验证并回放轨迹。
  • ChemWorld 是软件模型环境，不生成真实实验室操作规程。
  • 仓库中的 Agent 证据是有限资格测试，不代表某个 Provider 或 Agent 普遍更优。

docs.title: 公共分发
docs.text:
本仓库选择性发布ChemWorld开发源码。使用uv sync --locked --extra dev安装， 或用uv build构建wheel与源码包。源码版本仍为0.5.0.dev0，仓库更新不代表发布新PyPI版本。

分发包含运行时、已批准的模拟器资源、环境CLI、Python示例及可选CPU构建源码。 研究输入、私有评测集、凭据、提供方原始响应、内部界面原型与论文素材不进入分发。 源码包可脱离研究仓库重新构建。

唯一控制台命令是chemworld；历史评测应用通过显式归档入口使用。 原生工作流不需要上游化学求解器，可选参考库用于另外的独立比较。 具体检查范围见当前基座。

旧论文结果使用冻结源码和依赖，当前物理不保证重现所有历史轨迹。

docs.title: 最新开发进展 — 2026年10月25日
docs.text:
主库开发已继续向前推进。下列增量已提交到主库，尚未纳入当前公共安装包； 公共版本可用的内容单独列在下一节。

方向 最新开发内容 当前范围 流程网络 有限图连接显式进料、分流、混合、换热、分离和多个回路；有限库存与轨迹控制消费者沿用同一世界状态。 边界与初始化修复正在核验，完整固定范围资格仍在进行。 电池观测 半电池 DFN 读数支持序列化与恢复，并核对模型和字段。 读数仍是派生观测，不是第二份设备状态，也不代表整个半电池任务已完成。 机理互操作 已支持的导入 Cantera 气相网络可保留原物种、反应与单位声明进行导出。 要求完整来源声明；不支持或来源缺失的网络明确拒绝。 物性拟合 物理灵敏度诊断要求原模型的有限差分评估实际成功。 优化器惩罚值本身不能证明参数可辨识性，失败尝试继续保留。

当前开发总表的56张父任务完成39张、5张推进中、12张待做；独立 CPU 路线 31张任务完成4张。任务完成与软件参考比较不等于所有材料都获验证， 完整科学模型执行仍使用 Python。

docs.title: 公共源码中已提供的功能
docs.text:
公共 Python 运行时仍对应10月25日同步的源码快照 823b6b01f。 从环境作者指南选择设备并声明操作、资源边界， 再接入 Agent，按需定义奖励。三步用户奖励示例已随包提供。

方向 公共版本可用范围 热力学与界面 分子／缔合／多流体模型、多相热量闪蒸、有限过程消费和平面界面计算 反应与生化系统 反应器网络、能量输运、导入机理、SBML／COPASI互操作及有界混合动力学 水处理与电化学 有限膜／处理流程、活性污泥、电池参数与滞后族，以及选定半电池和热工作流 环境使用 用户自定义目标与奖励、持久状态、资源边界、观测和回放 可选 CPU 开发 语义声明、资源／历史基础及 C++20 ABI／绑定骨架；完整数值模型迁移仍在推进

安装注册表声明31个模块、38类部件、52个操作和30类仪器。这些是软件声明数量， 不代表独立科学领域数，也不代表任意世界都能使用全部组合。官网构建时直接读取 公共注册表计数；能力图谱仍是帮助阅读的内容目录。

通过 Python、CLI 或 Agent 接口使用。旧 Student Lab 命令已退役， Research Workbench 与 Blender Lab 仍是内部原型。

docs.title: 验证与历史证据
docs.text:
公共运行时同步时，82个可执行 API 示例通过；wheel 与源码包在 Windows Python 3.11.15 上独立安装通过，覆盖原生工作流及新进程回放。这些结果对应公共运行时， 不替代上方最新开发增量的验证。 公共同步记录 保留具体范围和分母。

官网首页、能力图谱与领域指南统一使用原来的界面，由 / 进入。 文档在一体化阅读器中展示，保留领域目录、章节导航和代码复制；旧 /explore/ 与指南地址仍可使用。 本轮更新网站内容，不改变运行时、PyPI 版本或论文结果。

冻结 Notebook 与轨迹演示继续对应各自的原运行时版本，见证据与 Notebook。当前物理不保证与历史轨迹逐数值兼容；完整上游资格、 更广平台覆盖与大部分 CPU 执行任务仍在推进。

docs.title: 设计自己的实验环境
docs.text: 从已支持的物理领域选择设备和模型，声明可用操作、仪器与资源，然后把环境交给自己的Agent。 实验问题、探索策略、奖励与评价由使用者决定。当前入口是WorldCompositionSpec与 ChemWorldRuntime；能力及参数范围由实际安装的模块声明决定。

docs.title: 修改一个可运行的环境
docs.text:
下面复用原生表面反应环境，设置两个研究容器的温控范围、单次操作时长和总操作预算。 容器、有限气源、催化剂与热模型来自现有构造器；这是合成参数示例，不代表真实催化剂预测。 代码只创建设计和读取接口，没有为Agent预排实验动作。

import json
from pathlib import Path

from chemworld.runtime import ChemWorldRuntime
from chemworld.world.composition import WorldCompositionSpec
from chemworld.world.surface_world import surface_world_spec

design = surface_world_spec(terminal_assay=False).to_dict()
design["composition_id"] = "my-two-vessel-study"
design["task"]["objective"] = "Investigate how heating changes measured gas composition"
design["task"]["budget"] = 24
for component in design["components"]:
    if component["kind"] == "thermal":
        component["parameters"]["temperature_range_K"] = [330, 410]
        component["parameters"]["duration_range_s"] = [1, 60]

spec = WorldCompositionSpec.from_dict(design)
Path("world.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(spec.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
)
session = ChemWorldRuntime(composition=spec, observation_noise_mode="keyed")
try:
    session.reset(seed=12)
    print(session.task_prompt()["text"])
    print(session.available_actions())
    print(session.action_schema("heat"))
finally:
    session.close()

在自己的工作目录保存脚本及world.json。声明解析与运行时编译会检查部件兼容性和参数； 填写一个模块名并不会安装新物理能力。换用其他领域时，先查看领域工作流 和安装能力，再使用对应的已支持构造器／模型声明。

docs.title: 让Agent操作环境
docs.text:
用户宿主加载world.json并创建会话，将研究问题、task_prompt()、动作规格和已取得的原生观测 交给Agent。Agent自行决定下一步，宿主调用validate_action(action)和execute(action)， 保存执行记录后返回公开结果。读取observe()不会重新测量，也不会推进时钟。

测量值取自result.observation.to_dict()["native"]["channels"]，连同单位、质量、采样时间和 不确定度一起保留。未测量不等于零，上一轮缓存的读数不等于新实验结果。世界声明、完整 result.info和会话快照属于宿主；其中可能包含Agent不应看到的物理参数或内部诊断。

无评分环境的提示采用用户声明的objective，不要求优化内置分数或提交Agent清单。 结构化字段中的trajectory_validity用于记录／回放检查，不是Agent表现指标。 是否设置奖励可参考普通Python奖励示例。 终结规则按当前世界声明生效；上面的环境不要求终检，其他环境可以显式声明终检仪器。

docs.title: 记录、恢复与展示
docs.text:
• 保存动作和原生测量，使用现有轨迹记录与回放接口检查执行是否可复现。
  • session.snapshot()保存私有状态，ChemWorldRuntime.from_snapshot(...)用于延续兼容会话。
  • 模型调用预算由用户宿主管理，与环境操作预算分别计账；需要模型总结时提前保留额度。
  • Research Workbench与Blender Lab暂缓发布，当前通过环境API及CLI操作。

docs.title: 与旧研究协议的区别
docs.text: 历史应用归档中的Work I world-fork协议规定受控对照实验的单变量修改与冻结证据。 它不是当前自定义环境的通用作者流程。复现该研究时仍使用其绑定版本；创建设备环境从本页开始。

docs.title: 使用可编程环境
docs.text: ChemWorld提供多领域物理模型、可组合设备、实验操作、原生单位观测、资源记录和回放。 Agent、实验目标、奖励函数和评价方法由使用者定义。自由探索不要求使用某个内置Agent，也不要求提交排行榜。

docs.title: 安装与查看能力
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/sunyrain/ChemWorld-Public.git
cd ChemWorld-Public
uv sync --locked --extra dev
uv run --no-sync chemworld capabilities --format json
uv run --no-sync python -m chemworld.examples.user_reward

安装wheel后直接运行其环境中的chemworld和python -m chemworld.examples.user_reward。 分发名暂时保留chemworld-bench，本次没有更名或发布新版本。

docs.title: 接入自己的Agent
docs.text:
先按环境作者指南选择设备、设置操作边界和资源，再接入自己的Agent。

from chemworld.runtime import ChemWorldRuntime
from chemworld.world.surface_world import surface_world_spec

session = ChemWorldRuntime(composition=surface_world_spec())
try:
    session.reset(seed=12)
    print(session.available_actions())
    print(session.action_schema("add_component"))
    # 用自己的Agent决定下一步；不需要继承内置Agent或使用固定奖励。
    action = {"operation": "add_component", "component": "CO-feed", "amount_mol": 6e-5}
    result = session.execute(action)
    print(result.observation.to_dict())
finally:
    session.close()

读取原生observation.native.channels中的数值、单位、质量和样品时间。尚未测量不等于零； 读取已有观测不会生成新测量。允许的操作和实体由世界声明及当前状态决定。 宿主负责保留内部执行诊断；不要把完整result.info或私有快照直接发送给受限Agent。

已有工具调用研究路径提供MCP操作、公开历史、测量文件和可选笔记本。 InteractiveCodexExperimentAgent是仍在使用的提供方接入实现，不是自由探索能力的唯一入口。 独立第三方MCP宿主的启动接入尚未在本轮验证；Python接口可以直接由用户控制。

docs.title: 奖励与评价由用户定义
docs.text:
chemworld.examples.user_reward仅展示普通Python函数：根据新取得的压力读数计算用户目标， 也可以传入reward_fn=None完全不打分。更换奖励不改变环境物理。 示例的目标值和缩放是示例作者选择，不是官方成功标准。

当前底层仍保留供已有研究／Gym消费者使用的reward、任务终结及历史评分字段； 它们不是新应用必须采用的目标。本轮归档入口没有改动这些执行语义。 可直接忽略旧奖励，根据公开观测和资源消耗计算自己的奖励，或在宿主侧编写独立评价。 若评价需要私有真值，应由可信评价端消费，不能回传给被评测Agent。

docs.title: 环境工具
docs.text:
• chemworld capabilities：从模块声明读取安装能力。
  • chemworld render --composition world.json --actions action.json --format json：执行给定操作。
  • chemworld verify --submission trajectory.jsonl：检查记录能否回放，不评价Agent好坏。
  • session.snapshot()与ChemWorldRuntime.from_snapshot(...)：保存和延续支持的物理会话。

docs.title: 界面发布状态
docs.text:
当前只保留Research Workbench与Blender Lab两组内部界面原型，均暂缓公开发布。 Task Lab、轻量Lab控制台、Experiment Explorer和Asset Preview已从源码移除。 当前sdist／wheel不包含这些界面及专用后端，也不注册chemworld-lab命令。 用户通过Python API、chemworld环境CLI或Agent工具接口操作基座；静态文档站展示说明和案例。

进一步阅读原生基座、领域工作流、 共享实验室和发行范围。 离线研究例子展示一种用户评价模板，不是全环境强制协议。 旧排行榜、基线和逐步LLM适配见历史入口。

docs.title: 证据
docs.text:
当前基座见10月更新。下文已有图示与数值证据对应8月冻结运行时。

ChemWorld v0.3.0 完整保留 v0.2.0 的四组冻结净化证据。新增展示层不会引入新的 benchmark 实验。

证据组 冻结结果 支持的判断 Composition qualification 64/64 个单元；1,786/1,786 条 recipe 注册世界组合与参考执行 Deterministic use cases 8/8 个案例；89 个提交动作 生命周期、失败、资源和精确回放语义 Controlled world forks 6 对世界；24 条轨迹 固定公开实验下的单组件世界变化 Agent instrument use 1 条生命周期；15 个提交动作 持续使用公开动作与仪器接口

docs.title: 为什么图示可审计
docs.text: scripts/build_readme_visuals.py 只读取净化后的压缩报告，并重新生成 README SVG、网站交互数据和详细静态表。任何输出过期时，--check 都会失败。

docs.title: 来源与净化
docs.text:
每份压缩报告都会绑定原报告 SHA-256、净化器版本、公开协议，以及被移除元数据的摘要哈希。规范化 JSON 与 gzip mtime=0 使净化过程可重复。

参见完整报告地图、代表性行为表和发布 manifest。

有限声明边界

通过这些检查不代表普适化学保真度、通用 Agent 智能或能够安全迁移到真实实验室。

docs.title: 原生扩展与模型范围
docs.text:
公开 Python 后端已包含下列有限模型族。当前基座记录源码与验证状态， API 指南给出可执行输入和输出。

领域 已实现范围 共同基座 自有状态、残差/DAE、局部/共享时钟、有限资源、排队测量、精确续算与回放 热力学 活度/UNIFAC/立方模型、Helmholtz、IF97/冰/湿空气/不可压缩工质、选定分子/缔合/多流体 EOS、局部稳定性与闪蒸 工程过程 流体关联式、分子热力学串联单元、单回路、有限接收器及有界设计 反应与输运 气相/表面化学导入、有限图规则生成、能粒、反应器网络、壁面/活塞/热耦合及有限一维输运 水相与分离 来源化水相/矿物、反应输运、顶空、RO/NF/MD/ED、吸附、树脂/GAC、沉淀、澄清、过滤和洗涤 固相 选定 CALPHAD/ChemSage 模型、多相 CEF TP/PH、有限二元/三元相图搜索 电池 SPM/SPMe/DFN、粒径分布、复合/MSMR/半电池等有限模型族、选定控制/热模型、SEI/析锂、阻抗及健康状态 随机与生化分析 直接法/next-reaction、显式分区混合过程与有限 tau-leap；SBML/SED-ML 子集、稳态/控制、拟合、剖面、通量模式和有限时域增长

docs.title: 当前边界
docs.text:
各模型显式声明来源、单位、相态和有效范围；部分为合成示范，部分含来源化参数。 方程已实现不等于所有材料均获验证。电池与分子热力学主任务仍在推进，独立子模型分别 保留其固定比较结果。

公共包仍提供有界串联与单回路过程消费者。通用有限流程图及其库存／控制集成已在主库推进， 见最新进展。通用自由传播火焰、不受限全局相包络、 完整上游数据库与普适长期老化仍不属于已交付范围。可选 C++ 构建骨架已提供， 科学计算内核及 SIMD 迁移仍在进行。 可用耦合组合见共享时钟。

docs.title: 参考与复用
docs.text: 生产求解使用原生 Python 后端，可选上游求解器用于独立参考。解析极限、守恒和固定 比较案例检查已实现切片；数值一致不免除来源、数据归属或许可证义务。 用户提供的数据库保留其原许可证。

docs.title: 历史应用归档
docs.text:
ChemWorld当前定位是可编程物理环境。旧排行榜、官方基线工厂和逐操作LLM适配器已退出默认入口。 当前使用入口见可编程环境。

设计新环境请使用当前作者指南。保留的 Work I world-authoring contract是冻结研究的受控fork协议， 其单变量修改、证书和冻结流程不约束一般环境开发。原文路径及内容因历史证据绑定保持不变； v1组合合同也按其首篇论文研究范围阅读。

历史功能 显式归档入口 run、evaluate、leaderboard、suite、baselines、submission及旧发布流程 python -m chemworld.legacy.cli --help 旧排行榜汇总 chemworld.legacy.leaderboard 预设策略工厂 chemworld.legacy.agent_registry.make_agent 11个旧基线／适配模块 chemworld.legacy.agents：bo、greedy、lhs、random、event、rl、llm、live_llm、diagnostic_live_llm、documented_codex_g2、structured_g2

归档应用保留现有研究辅助消费者的明确导入，仍随当前源码分发，但不再作为环境推荐用法或默认评分。 旧路径不提供静默重导出。共享run_agent、MCP自由探索、笔记本和实际使用的研究实现继续存在。 内核／轨迹中的历史字段尚有消费者，本次没有用重命名改变物理、资源或已有结果。

旧文档和迁移前源码保存在Git提交3e5fe32598d96c4ab2b83fcfb26b48939c26c967。 复现冻结实验仍应使用实验原绑定版本与数据；迁移后的归档入口不是旧物理模拟器。 本次没有重跑、更新或重新认证历史实验结果。

docs.title: 适用边界与安全解释
docs.text:
ChemWorld 是用于受控 Agent 研究的软件模型环境，不是生成真实实验室操作规程的工具。

  • 资格测试只覆盖有限的注册任务、组合、探针和 world fork，不代表全部化学空间。
  • 公开观测由声明的软件模型与仪器生成，不构成实验保真度认证。
  • 教程 recipe 只演示接口使用，不是优化实验方案，也不是对真实材料的操作建议。
  • 精确回放表示软件轨迹在发布合同下可复现，不代表复现真实实验的不确定性。
  • 受控隐藏组件属于评测者的研究设计工具，Agent 不应获得直接 hidden-state 访问。

仓库不包含论文文件、未公开结果、开发实验矩阵、原始 Provider 响应或私有评测配置。

准确的发布声明请以证据页面和 scripts/verify_release.py 为准。

docs.title: 有限的低复制世界
docs.text:
中文预览译文；技术接口与适用范围请同时核对英文原文。

两个合成世界运行在原生会话和任务-36的直接策略 SSA 上： biochemical_world("reversible") (A与B的关系) 以及 biochemical_world("enzyme") (E+S→ES, ES→E+S, ES→E+P)。这些是数值示例，而不是经过生物学验证的系统。 合成 E 是 N2，而 ES 是 CH2N2O，因此结合保持了原子的存在。 这种反应不涉及迈克尔-门腾还原，也没有隐式的 ODE/SSA 切换。

在没有模型密钥或 COPASI 的情况下运行：

uv run --no-sync python examples/native_biochemical.py
uv run --no-sync pytest tests/test_biochemical_worlds.py tests/test_stochastic_kinetics.py -q

普通 add_component 动作接受 mol 单位，但每次剂量必须精确地表示分子数量（在浮点数转换舍入误差范围内）。 0/1 索引对应可逆过程， E/S 对应酶。 此处不支持任何小数舍入、载体添加、热控或流控。 元素之间的转换以精确的整数原子为准，而不是宏观的 mol 容差。 mol 账本仍然是唯一的库存；计数是推导出来的视图。

molecule_counter 报告带独立高斯噪声的有符号校准计数（标准差为 1 个计数，每个分子的响应为一个单位），绝不输出事件真值。molecule_capture 以 0.1 的概率独立选择每个溶质分子，将选中的分子转移到仪器废弃物中，并使用相同的探测器噪声进行测量。这是 理想化的分子捕获 ，不是抽取液体等分试样；载液体积保持不变。分析在离线仪器时钟上耗时 1 s，反应器不演化。两种读取的成本均为 0.01。捕获真值和采样随机数生成器保持私有。空通道或噪声通道不会被隐含真值悄然替换。模型不声称支持饱和效应或未知物种识别。

“种子”的定义在世界级别声明，检测器“种子”在会话重置时使用，捕获使用从世界“种子”中导出的独立持久流。读取不会影响后续反应或捕获；实际的剂量/捕获会使待处理的事件失效。快照保留所有后续状态，以及材料/批次/容器的初始化会恢复已声明的离散状态（包括其初始的种子）。因此，多次重置是确定性的重新初始化，而不是独立的副本：为独立的进程副本创建一个新的世界，并使用新的种子。使用固定装置可以容忍材料的重置。快照包含评估者的真实信息，而不是代理的观察。

可选的外部引用块（无默认依赖，可以选择新的输出）：

uv run --no-sync --with python-copasi==4.48.309 python scripts/validate_native_biochemical.py --output /tmp/biochemical-attempt.json

固定发展的设计和完整的 8,288 个端点数据位于 workstreams/world_foundation/NATIVE_BIOCHEMICAL_ACCEPTANCE.md 和 NATIVE_BIOCHEMICAL_RESULTS.json 中。它比较瞬态/有效平衡的二项分布、有限的 COPASI 端点分布以及体积/计数比例缩放的 ODE 归一化。有限分布的一致性并不能证明所有动力学状态或实验室预测的有效性。一个通用的分子计数器和合成捕获是明确的简化，而不是对特定物理实验的建模。

docs.title: 已安装的原生能力声明
docs.text:
当前为 31 个模块、38 类部件、51 种操作、27 种仪器。下表由运行时注册表生成， 保留英文合同原文以精确呈现每个模型的范围；中文领域概览见扩展范围。 实际动作还受组装、设备与任务约束，模块声明不保证任意跨域耦合。

Module Components / strategies Scope aqueous_gas_transfer aqueous_gas_transfer, finite-aqueous-gas-transfer Finite ideal-gas headspace and ideal aqueous liquid in one rigid isothermal vessel; reversible sourced gas/liquid transfer and fast aqueous reactions, actual gas pressure and same-reference internal-energy bath duty; optional seeded pure-mineral kinetics with actual solid volume displacing the headspace. Nonvolatile solvent, fixed liquid volume and zero solute partial volumes; no infinite gas source, pressure flow or spontaneous mineral nucleation. aqueous_mineral aqueous_mineral, finite-carbonate-calcite-equilibrium Authored finite aqueous acid/base/complexation and mineral equilibrium; explicit thermodynamic data and ionic-strength domain, not a geochemical database. Also finite same-T/P solution mixing, nonideal equilibrium precipitation and dilution with liquid-only packets, original solid inventory, same-reference enthalpy and pressure-volume work; instantaneous equilibrium, not nucleation kinetics. aqueous_reactive_transport aqueous_reactive_transport, finite-aqueous-reactive-transport Sealed one-dimensional ideal-dilute aqueous transport at fixed T/P; finite stationary water, zero solute partial volumes, zero-current electrodiffusion, fast equilibrium and declared slow neutral conversion. Also finite feed/collector throughflow with conservative upwind advection, common mechanical dispersion and actual water/solute/enthalpy transfer; prescribed kinematic flow at common T/P, without a pump model. Strictly positive ions; no pressure flow, mineral or external circuit. battery_spm battery_spm, battery_cell, single-particle-battery Synthetic SPM with calorics/SEI, or explicit isothermal SPMe-v1 with conservative electrolyte transport; shared native cycling. Explicit isothermal DFN has coupled spatial reactions and a fixed synthetic qualification at 24 through-plane cells per region / 64 radial cells. Explicit isothermal Newman-Tobias uses two average lithium inventories and spatial porous electrical fields, without radial diffusion or dynamic salt; its fixed CV grid-inventory qualification remains open. Development MPM adds shared-potential size populations with independent inventories; independent MPM scientific qualification remains pending. Isothermal single-material SPM/MPM may declare current-sigmoid OCP or one persistent Axen hysteresis coordinate per electrode; no hysteresis thermal/SEI coupling or equilibrium-SOH interpretation. Through-thickness thermal SPM uses three finite layers and two collectors, constant net OCV and local BV temperature feedback with ambient cooling; no arbitrary external thermal device or general material thermal claim. Isothermal MSMR-SPM uses one or two explicit reactions per electrode with potential-driven radial diffusion and shared branch kinetics; no MSMR thermal, EIS or automatic equilibrium-SOH claim. Composite SPM supports two independent negative material phases and one positive phase with single-valued monotone OCV, including internal exchange at zero terminal current; no thermal/SEI, EIS, SOH or energy closure. Positive-working half-cell SPM uses finite lithium metal with explicitly fixed geometry; no half-cell thermal/SEI, EIS, SOH or energy closure. Coarser meshes and other parameters need convergence checks; Closed volume-consistent isothermal lead-acid LOQS uses six real chemical inventories and the same runtime; no heat, side reactions, EIS or automatic SOH. Synthetic parameters are not wet-lab validation. Split OCV-R uses two finite mean Li inventories, separate electrode OCV and capacity, and series resistance; no particle diffusion, BV or heat. Its EIS and equilibrium SOH reuse the same declared inventory model. No PyBaMM runtime backend. battery_thevenin battery_thevenin, thevenin-empirical-circuit Sourced empirical RC and two-node cell/jig heat model; shared CC/CV control and persistent apparatus. No chemical inventory/total energy, diffusion element or independent released-model qualification yet. continuous_flow continuous_flow See the authored physical spec and runtime contract; no universal validity claim. core material_input, sample_storage, reaction See the authored physical spec and runtime contract; no universal validity claim. crystallization aqueous_filter, crystal_thermal, crystallization, finite-crystal-population-temperature Authored crystal seeding, cooling and wet-cake operations; also declared same-T/P instantaneous aqueous mineral filtration into two finite empty receivers, with explicit solid capture and mother-liquid retention, actual leaked solids, wet-cake washing and repeat separation. Database filtration has no drying, pressure-drop or filtration-rate model. distillation distillation See the authored physical spec and runtime contract; no universal validity claim. dynamic_distillation dynamic_distillation, finite-equilibrium-column Finite tray/receiver inventories, heat and timed cuts; authored small dynamic column, not arbitrary plant design. electrical_control transient_electrode, finite-transient-electrode See the authored physical spec and runtime contract; no universal validity claim. electrochemistry electrochemistry See the authored physical spec and runtime contract; no universal validity claim. finite_transport finite_transport, finite-pump-transport Finite pump, pipe, tanks and authored heat exchange; bounded working point; or four finite tanks and two pumps exchanging countercurrent heat at declared UA with independent circuit flows; or declared isothermal zero-order liquid treatment chains with finite product/concentrate stocks and receipt-based engineering economics; or finite pump-fed neutral reactive holdup with ideal overflow to a finite product tank, volume-compatible chemistry and one shared bath; or finite neutral aqueous mixed-contact adsorption and rinse with persistent competitive loading, five liquid stocks and one shared bath; or finite ideal-dilute Na/Ca resin exchange with counterion release, salt regeneration and rinse across six liquid stocks, weighted fixed resin charge and one shared bath; or finite neutral suspensions with a declared jar-test endpoint, explicit dispersed/floc particle phases, empirical clarification into actual clear-water/wet-sludge tanks, and mixing/pump work; no additive-driven coagulation prediction or settling dynamics; the adsorption-world feed also supports read-only single-solute fresh GAC design and breakthrough queries at fixed influent, using actual pump flow and feed volume above pickup; not remaining-life prediction for existing LDF media. These are declared finite models, not arbitrary multiphase process-network simulation. gas_reactor_network gas_reactor_network, finite-isothermal-gas-network Finite isothermal ideal-gas reactors, storage and collection nodes; declared molar/mass flow and one-way pressure valves; shared time, material transfers and bath heat; or explicit per-node energy with finite vessel heat capacities, source-temperature enthalpy transport, environment/neighbor heat exchange and one queued anchor heater. Complete imported ideal surfaces can share the same gas network, owned site stocks and calorics. Also sealed or finite-feed/collector isothermal low-Mach planar cells with common grid pressure, independent tank pressures, continuity-derived bulk flow and whole-mixture diffusion; prescribed boundary molar flow has no momentum or compressor model. Alternatively one constant-load finite-stroke ideal-gas piston with actual EOS volume and separately booked pressure work, without surfaces or spatial cells. Constant-volume energy networks can instead declare one finite-heat-capacity wall with its own persistent temperature, gas contact conduction and grey radiation/conduction to an environment. No wall/piston, wall/surface or wall/spatial coupling; no piston inertia, spatial flame field or arbitrary member heat queues. Sourced finite harmonic state counting can compile one-well RRKM channels into the original energy-grain populations and bath collisions, with explicit ZPE and quantization; no rotor, tunneling or general pressure-rate reduction. Read-only single-well QSD rates, product branches and spectral gaps use current original grains and actual bath inventory or explicit fixed T/bath-pressure grids; no dynamic reduction, total-pressure PLog or new heat/inventory model. lab_schedule lab_schedule Single process; finite independent closed systems with explicitly declared shared-clock strategies and atomic finite pump/membrane paths; explicit finite heater/analyzer identities with FIFO occupancy; no same-vessel hybrid or general loops. liquid_equilibrium liquid_equilibrium, isothermal-liquid-equilibrium Strict finite liquid phase equilibrium using declared component properties and supported composition domain; no silent extrapolation. mineral_kinetics mineral_kinetics, finite-calcite-kinetics Finite calcite dissolution/precipitation with fast aqueous equilibrium; fixed 298.15 K; or declared database minerals at fixed TP with fast aqueous reactions, finite seeded surface and same-reference heat/work. Database mode currently permits wait only; no mineral nucleation. molecular_process molecular_process, molecular-process-receiver Declared external source through homogeneous serial units or one recycle loop into one finite receiver; wait and snapshots; local clock only. observation observation See the authored physical spec and runtime contract; no universal validity claim. phase phase See the authored physical spec and runtime contract; no universal validity claim. programmed_chromatography programmed_chromatography Authored peak/retention response, finite sampling and persistent carryover; not a fitted universal chromatographic transport model. ro_membrane ro_membrane, finite-dilute-ro Finite ideal dilute NaCl RO at 298.15 K with deposited foulant/rinse, or declared binary-electrolyte axial RO with pressure loss, same-source aqueous calorics and three finite tanks; or ideal dilute multi-ion Donnan/steric/Born NF with a resolved pore and a mixed-feed 0D module; or a periodic internal AEM/CEM electrodialysis pair with two finite liquids, signed ion/water transfer and bounded CC/CV control; or two-tank direct-contact Knudsen membrane distillation with finite heat/cooling and signed water/energy transfer; model-specific T/P/salinity bounds and operations, no membrane holdup or full WaterTAP flowsheet. sbml sbml_model, formal-sbml-shared Formal 3D SBML quantity coordinates and supported transverse events; no declared chemical formula, carrier mass or heat model. Read-only finite-time perturbation growth for smooth autonomous reaction ODEs uses an explicit mol metric and the original stoichiometric subspace; no event/rate-rule tangents or asymptotic chaos claim. separation separation See the authored physical spec and runtime contract; no universal validity claim. solid_solution solid_solution, calphad_phase, binary-solid-equilibrium Finite binary equilibrium, selected native TDB/CEF phase, or declared multiphase CEF PH equilibrium with latent heat and finite thermal device; finite phase and tangent search, without global uniqueness claims. Fixed-T/P neutral vacancy-free ternary CEF sections retain requested composition nodes, tie lines/triangles and failed points; read-only world queries solve the exact current elemental composition, without interpolating continuous boundaries or replacing live inventory. sorbent_contact sorbent_contact Competitive finite sorbent kinetics, owned carrier and finite wash; explicit condensed calorics and temperature domain. stochastic stochastic, gillespie-direct Integer Gillespie direct or explicit Gibson-Bruck next-reaction; constant volume/temperature mass action, persistent channel clocks and RNG; or declared fixed-partition continuous/stochastic feedback with integrated hazards, no cross-partition net conversion and no consuming sampling; not spatial kMC, tau-leaping or automatic ODE/SSA switching. surface_kinetics surface_reaction Finite owned sites; declared single/multisite mean-field mechanisms and symmetric interactions; not spatial kMC or a real catalyst fit. thermal thermal, heater_connection, owned-inventory-temperature, static-finite-carrier-stock, legacy-liquid-enthalpy Finite-power or explicitly isothermal device; shared energy accounting; manual reconnection requires one disabled heater in local-clock mode. vacuum_concentration vacuum_concentration, finite-vacuum-concentration-enthalpy Finite variable-composition concentration with authored VLE/calorics; unsupported kinetic coupling is rejected. vapor_liquid_equilibrium vapor_liquid_equilibrium, constant-pressure-flash-enthalpy Finite TP/PH closure with explicit phase/caloric models, including simultaneous two-phase molecular PH on a declared local branch with finite thermal devices and explicit constant-pressure boundary work; no simultaneous undeclared kinetic process.

For declared action units, parameter rules, state ownership and dependencies: uv run --no-sync python -m chemworld.examples.native_capabilities --format json

docs.title: 可选 CPU 构建边界
docs.text: ChemWorld 的 Python/reference 路径不需要 C++ 编译器。当前主线提供一个隔离的 C++20 CPU ABI 骨架，供后续原生执行任务接入；它只演示受控句柄、单世界操作和批量操作的构建与绑定，不把 现有 Python 科学模块宣称为已经迁移到 C++。

docs.title: 构建与 smoke test
docs.text:
在仓库根目录执行：

uv run --no-sync python scripts/build_cpu.py --test

脚本会把中间文件和安装结果放在 build/chemworld-cpu/。需要指定 Windows 生成器时可以写：

uv run --no-sync python scripts/build_cpu.py --generator "Visual Studio 17 2022" --test

构建结果的 ABI 是 chemworld-cpu-abi-1，导出的是 C 形状接口：reset、observe、step 和 step_batch。当前 fixture 操作码为 0（observe）、1（add）和 2（scale）；它们只用于验证 绑定边界，不代表化学模型。接口不跨越 STL 容器或 C++ 对象布局，适合后续生成薄绑定；native 库的安装目录 包含 chemworld_cpu_build.json，记录 ABI、配置和安装位置。

docs.title: Python 选择规则
docs.text:
from chemworld.cpu import CpuBackendUnavailable, CpuWorld, select_backend

backend = select_backend("auto")       # 缺少库时返回 "reference"
try:
    cpu_backend = select_backend("cpu")  # 显式请求时缺失会抛出异常
except CpuBackendUnavailable:
    cpu_backend = "reference"

也可以通过 CHEMWORLD_CPU_LIBRARY 指定共享库路径。auto 只在初始化阶段选择一次完整执行器； 原生步骤失败不会静默切换到另一套执行器。基础 wheel 不携带 C++ 工具链或运行时库，预编译的 CPU 构建由相同 CMake 入口安装，科学 capability 声明仍来自唯一的 Python DomainModuleRegistry。

docs.title: 运行集成后的原生示例
docs.text:
中文预览译文；技术接口与适用范围请同时核对英文原文。

这些是固定的合成开发工作流程，而不是自主的模型运行或与真实实验室数据的拟合。它们使用与原生领域相同的 ChemWorldRuntime、Gym、CLI、交易系统和回放功能。不需要任何模型密钥或可选的化学后端。预装的入口点位于 wheel 和 sdist 中，不需要导入任何测试辅助工具或仅限于仓库的配置。

从受保护的存储环境：

uv run --no-sync python -m chemworld.examples.native_domains --output /tmp/native-domains
uv run --no-sync chemworld verify --submission /tmp/native-domains/heater.jsonl
uv run --no-sync python -m chemworld.examples.native_capabilities --format json

在虚拟环境中安装了内置轮后，对应的输入是 python -m chemworld.examples.native_domains --output /tmp/native-domains。 使用 --workflow NAME 选择一个，或重复使用以选择多个。 输出结果是实际的动作/读数轨迹和终端快照，而不是虚构的分数。

工作流程 它锻炼的是什么？ heater 一个校准后的有限加热装置：气体表面反应 → 液相吸附 → 热能 SPM。 相同的装置移动，而不是复制。 每个容器都保留自身的材料和本地经过的时间。 membrane 在有限的进水/泵/RO系统/渗透水和清洗/废液物料库存中，进行三次清洗/冲洗循环；污垢仍然存在，且没有进行补水/重置。 mineral 碳酸盐/方解石的动力学过程，有限的酸性物质输入，相转移，采样和pH值。 shared-clock 独立的、低复制率的 A/B 和 SSA 型号，以及确定性的 A/B 型号，向一个离线分子计数器发出两个竞争性请求，导致结果延迟，并且持续运行 RNG。 distillation 有限的托盘残留，保留接收器，定时分液收集，完全回流和回流变化。 crystal 播种、有限冷却/生长、过滤、重新悬浮、温和溶解以及第二次冷却间隔。 solid 二元分离 → 加热 → 局部平衡状态下冷却，并读取原生相。

docs.title: 设备和时间界限
docs.text:
reconnect_heater 是一种在明确编写的系统中，不涉及物理时间或空间的连接动作。 本地时钟 组成部分。首先进行暂停控制；世界上必须只有一个热源设备，并且该设备必须与一个具有兼容原生温度域的目标进行匹配。该设备的身份、校准和设置必须保持不变；材料不得移动。使用 select_vessel 然后 heat 为了在新的目标位置运行。它不实现机器人的运动、空间碰撞避免或通用仪器的热插拔。如果连接被拒绝，则遵循正常的程序，但不会改变材料、设备或物理时间。

shared-clock的工作流程与众不同：所有启用的容器在第39条的有限调度器下，同时老化。它不进行和的关联。SSA以及ODE在单个容器内进行，分子捕获是零载体体积的伯努利采样，而不是液体分取。不要将使用相同种子多次重置解释为独立的实验。

使用 --noise-mode keyed 选择现有的已标记的探测器原型。例如，使用世界/进程种子 7 和独立的观察种子 12。每个输出都包含解析后的组成和字面动作序列，保存在 *-recipe.json 文件中。共享时钟示例明确声明了亚秒级的等待，以便快照可以保留一个繁忙的一秒分析器和一个未执行的 SSA 事件；它不会缩短分析器的物理分析时间。

一个由用户编写的共享时钟，使用 LabClockSpec(vessel_capacity=4, ...) 允许四个独立的闭环热/SSA容器。 默认值为两个；显式整数容量为 1–64，与有限的任务队列 capacity 区分。 1、2 和 4 个容器路径具有直接的功能覆盖。 所有声明的容器都会演化到相同的事件终点，包括未选择的容器。 更改声明顺序或选择另一个容器不会选择数值组装顺序。 一个物理加热器和一个离线分析仪提供持久的FIFO请求。如果切片失败，则会丢弃样本，RNG变化；现有的被拒绝操作的成本/风险惩罚已记录在案。超出已声明的有限设备、多个设备和同一容器的开放连接。ODE/SSA混合反应仍然缺乏充分的支持。

chemworld.examples.closed_shared_labs.reactive_closed_lab() 作者设计了四个独立的合成系统：一个基于热的A/B反应，热SPM电池、有限的吸附接触以及低复制SSA. phase_closed_lab() 结合了有限的晶体生长与独立的 Al/Cu 固体样品。 使用任何一种配方构建 ChemWorldRuntime(composition=...)，并使用 select_vessel、queue_lab_heat、可选的 queue_lab_measure 和 wait。 电力驱动是一种明确编写的初始程序；这些配方不添加控制器。 只有一个有限的热源在不同系统中移动，并且每个模型都保持自身的温度范围。 一种等温电池可以推进，但无法接受加热。 所有策略必须明确声明 shared_clock=True；单独安装模块并不能赋予这种能力。 物理上的截止点将所有系统同步到实际时间，并停止实验室。 这些组合使用现有的原生方程和合成参数；它们不建立材料的匹配。

chemworld.examples.open_shared_labs.open_shared_lab("transport") 将有限的资源（如泵/管道/换热器）与一个封闭式的热瓶结合起来。选择 "membrane" 对于有限的 RO 型号，保留污垢、清洗/废弃物，以及一个单独的容器。选择该装置的 reactor，打电话 set_flow_rate，然后使用 wait 为了全面提升实验室的水平。选择 bottle 以及 queue_lab_measure 在保持流动的同时，占据其一台离线色谱仪。现有的本地 run_flow 该操作无法在此引入第二个时钟。

每个有限的装置都会一次性运行，包括其来源和收集容器。配置的容器容量计算物理容器的数量：对于运输示例，为三个；对于污垢膜示例，为五个。有限的来源、收集限制或清洗结束，将所有系统与实际停止状态对齐。全球材料、泵的工作和热量保持在原始记录中；连接系统的参考信息出现在结果诊断中。在编译过程中，额外的路径、共享的储水池、未建模的循环以及重叠的策略所有权将被拒绝。这些配方重复使用原始的有限流动、稀释/等温膜和热方程。

docs.title: 残余值和热量计算器的选择
docs.text:
默认情况下，BatterySPMSpec 和 TransientElectrodeSpec 将使用 numerical_form="residual"。 将 numerical_form="ode" 设置为显式选择其原始 ODE 路径。 这种选择与物理模型一起保存，并在快照恢复后仍然有效。 即使求解失败仍然是一个数值错误，它不会选择其他算法。

两条路径都使用相同的有限物料库存、运输和反应方程、能量约定、设备限制和运行时交易。对于 SPM，残余路径同时解决电流和电压的约束条件，包括恒定电流、恒定电压和有限源电流的限制。非终止事件确定限制过渡。代数值出现在求解器诊断中，并从物理状态重新计算，它们不是另一个持久的库存。平面电极保持其现有的氧化还原、扩散和双层电荷模型以及等温能量范围。

常见的后端可以将常规的块索引-1 残差系统简化为：BDF或者 Radau。这并不是一个任意索引。DAE求解器。诊断功能分别识别解析和有限差分导数；常用的物理模型使用解析速率矩阵和显式数值状态/时间导数。

FiniteTransportSpec.caloric_algorithm 默认使用 "residual"，消耗相同的液体热焓、分析热容和仪器热容。 明确的 "brentq" 选择仍然可用。 caloric_residual_system 还可以提供针对目标能量和已声明的物理参数的原生温度响应。 如果缺少分析参数的导数，则报告为不可用。 这些数值选择均不扩大底层合成材料的适用范围。

docs.title: 能力和验证范围
docs.text:
请看 生成的模块表。它的来源是已安装的声明和它们的范围说明，而不是重复的可用性列表。实际的数值域来自编写好的物理和设备规格，并且受到任务权限的限制。两个模块的存在并不意味着它们之间的所有耦合都得到支持。SPM，稀释 0DRO并且，有限的二元平衡状态并不完整。PyBaMM, WaterTAP或者CALPHAD替代品。

导出实际的公共行动范围、材料连接以及已安装的仪器声明，用于生成一个食谱（或原始的组成文件）：

uv run --no-sync python -m chemworld.examples.native_capabilities --composition /tmp/native-domains/heater-recipe.json

本报告记录当前任务和活动容器的状态；未来的容器选择或物理状态变化可能会影响可用性。它重用运行时提供的公共合同，而不是维护一个单独的手动维护的范围表。

验证命令：

uv run --no-sync pytest tests/test_native_domains_end_to_end.py -v
uv run --no-sync python scripts/smoke_test_wheel.py --native-foundation-only --output /tmp/native-install.json

后者不仅构建了各个分布，还使用锁定默认依赖项，在仓库之外安装它们。它检查是否存在可选的上游库，运行七个示例，并在另一个进程中验证每个轨迹。这是一个本地安装测试。 不 包括 PyPI 的上传或正式发布。 接受记录中并未声称未实际测试的平台。

docs.title: PC-SAFT：局部混合物响应
docs.text:
合成二元 PC-SAFT 局部均相响应；机械稳定性不等于全局相稳定性，参数不代表真实物质。

import json
from chemworld.physchem.pcsaft import PCSAFTModel, SAFTSegment

inputs = {'temperature_K': 400,
 'molar_density_mol_m3': 20,
 'mole_fractions': [0.3, 0.7]}

    (SAFTSegment("light", 1, 3.4e-10, 120, "synthetic"),
     SAFTSegment("heavy", 2, 3.8e-10, 180, "synthetic")),
    ((0, 0.02), (0.02, 0)), (100, 1000), "synthetic")
state = molecular_eos_state(model, inputs["temperature_K"],
    inputs["molar_density_mol_m3"], tuple(inputs["mole_fractions"]))
output = state.to_dict()

print(json.dumps(output, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False))

docs.title: 热力学与工程接口
docs.text:
以下示例使用当前 Python 包，输入包含物理单位及显式系数；输出由展示代码实际生成。 能力网站同时提供函数签名和 JSON／键值表切换。

已交付热力学包括活度导数与有限拟合、由调用方提供基团数据的六种 UNIFAC 变体、 Twu／PPR78 与 GE 立方混合，以及共同均相求值接口。纯流体 Helmholtz 支持密度求根、 饱和、TP／PH／PS／T-rho 闪蒸及有限热过程。下面用理想气体极限演示接口；真实流体 需要显式来源系数与适用范围。现已加入选定分子、缔合与多流体模型，分别保留局部适用域与参数来源。

工程方法覆盖摩阻、管件、阀门、流量计、泵、填料床／塔、两相流、明渠、粒径分布 及设备几何，各方法保留自己的物理假设与工作域。

docs.title: 纯流体 Helmholtz 状态
docs.text:
自编理想气体系数演示：输入 K 与 mol/m³，输出有量纲物性。真实流体需提供来源系数；此处只检查均相局部稳定。

import json
from chemworld.physchem.helmholtz import HelmholtzFluid
from chemworld.physchem.helmholtz_terms import HelmholtzTerm

inputs = {'temperature_K': 400, 'molar_density_mol_m3': 20}

fluid = HelmholtzFluid(
    fluid_id="synthetic-monatomic", casrn="", molar_mass_kg_mol=0.04,
    gas_constant_J_mol_K=8.3, reducing_temperature_K=300,
    reducing_molar_density_mol_m3=1000, minimum_temperature_K=100,
    maximum_temperature_K=1500, maximum_pressure_Pa=1e9,
    ideal_terms=(
        HelmholtzTerm("IdealGasHelmholtzLead", {"a1": 0, "a2": 0}),
        HelmholtzTerm("IdealGasHelmholtzLogTau", {"a": 1.5}),
    ), residual_terms=(), source="Self-authored ideal-gas demonstration",
)
state = fluid.state(**inputs)
output = {key: state.to_dict()[key] for key in (
    "pressure_Pa", "enthalpy_J_mol", "cp_J_mol_K", "cv_J_mol_K",
    "compressibility_factor", "stability_scope",
)}

print(json.dumps(output, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False))

{

  "enthalpy_J_mol": 8300.0,
  "cp_J_mol_K": 20.75,

docs.title: 物性导数
docs.text:
显式热容关联式给出温度导数与所选参数的 Jacobian，保留单位与有效域；这是合成参数示例。

import json
from chemworld.physchem.specs import PropertyCorrelation
from chemworld.physchem.dippr import dippr_temperature_response, dippr_parameter_jacobian

inputs = {'temperature_K': 300,
 'coefficients': {'A': 25.0, 'B': 30.0, 'C': 800.0, 'D': 10.0, 'E': 400.0}}

curve = PropertyCorrelation(
    "synthetic-capacity", "dippr107", inputs["coefficients"],
    {"temperature": "K"}, "J/(mol*K)", "ideal_gas_heat_capacity",
    {"temperature": (200, 500)}, "Synthetic API demonstration")
response = dippr_temperature_response(curve, temperature_K=inputs["temperature_K"])
jacobian = dippr_parameter_jacobian(curve, [inputs["temperature_K"]], parameters=["A", "C"])
output = {"temperature_response": response.to_dict(), "parameter_jacobian": jacobian.to_dict()}

print(json.dumps(output, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False))
